name: Workspace List
description: Live Sandbox workspaces control panel. Top bar: shared-infra state with a Connect button (disabled while infra is up and healthy), default k8s port-forward health (click to re-check), and the kube context with a switch-to-dev button. Each workspace shows its container state, issue + status, and repo/open-PR counts, and expands to reveal action buttons (open in VS Code, open feature, start/stop/restart/down, close out, resume Claude in Terminal), its git repo worktrees and per-branch PRs, and an embedded Claude Code chat panel that continues the workspace's newest session (claude-transcript for history with tool-activity rows, fire-and-forget claude-send turns, claude-turn-status for exact turn tracking). Filter by name, issue ID, status, repo, branch, or PR title. Refreshes on reload.
